import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv"
OUTPUT_PATH = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)

# Define target columns in order of sample submission
TARGET_COLS = list(sample_df.columns)[1:]  # Exclude 'id'
N_TARGETS = len(TARGET_COLS)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Targets: {TARGET_COLS}")

# Preprocess features
text_col = "comment_text"
id_col = "id"

# Vectorize text
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 1))
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df[text_col])
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_col])

# Define Y for training
y_train = train_df[TARGET_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)

# Check dimensions
print(f"X_train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"y_train shape: {y_train.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")

# Split training data into train and validation sets
# Exclude validation rows from final model training to ensure valid hold-out score
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

# Convert to dense arrays for LightGBM
X_tr_dense = X_tr.toarray()
X_val_dense = X_val.toarray()

# Initialize and train models for each target
models = []
aucs = []

print("Training models on 80% of data (Validation score computed on hold-out)...")
for i, col in enumerate(TARGET_COLS):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        max_depth=6,
        verbose=-1,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )
    model.fit(X_tr_dense, y_tr[:, i])
    models.append(model)

    # Compute validation score
    val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_dense)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds)
    aucs.append(auc)
    print(f"Target {col} AUC (Validation): {auc:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(aucs)
print(f"\nMean Validation ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating submission file...")
submissions = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], N_TARGETS))
for i, model in enumerate(models):
    subs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    submissions[:, i] = subs

# Create submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submissions, columns=TARGET_COLS)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_df[id_col])

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
plan: This solution will convert the text comments into numerical features using TF-IDF vectorization and train six independent LightGBM classifiers to predict the toxicity probabilities for each target. To ensure a fair validation estimate, the training data will be split into a hold-out set that is excluded from model training, and the column-wise ROC AUC will be calculated on this unseen validation set. Finally, the models trained on the training split will be applied to the test set to generate the final submission file at `submission/submission.csv`.
